findings.issue_summary: **User-Initiated Collection**: Disclosure exempt, but **must be declared** in Play Store form.
findings.evidence: User-initiated login request extracts family_name/given_name and transmits them to the first-party backend via apiClient.
findings.recommendation: Declare Name collection in the Play Store Data Safety form.

findings.issue_summary: **Background Transfer (Disclosure Claimed)**: Evidence found; requires Critic verification.
findings.evidence: Wearable camera frames are transmitted in the background via maveSessionManager.sendVideoFrame. A compliant gatekeeper dialog was verified in WelcomeScreen.kt.
findings.recommendation: Ensure the Play Store Data Safety section also declares this transmission.
